bits.description: The number of bits used to quantize the vectors.

query_bits.description: The number of bits used to quantize the query vectors.

precondition.description: If `true`, the vectors are preconditioned before quantization.

oversample.description: The oversampling factor applied when rescoring.

node.description: The node ID of the node that holds the shard.

relocating_node.description: The node ID of the node the shard is relocating to. Only returned while the shard is relocating.

primary.description: If `true`, the shard is a primary shard.

state.description: The state of the shard, such as `STARTED` or `RELOCATING`.

attributes.description: Contains information about whether high compression was enabled and per-field vector formats.

committed.description:
If `true`, the segment is synced to disk. Segments that are synced can survive a hard reboot.
If `false`, the data from uncommitted segments is also stored in the transaction log so that Elasticsearch is able to replay changes on the next start.

compound.description: If `true`, Lucene merged all files from the segment into a single file to save file descriptors.

deleted_docs.description:
The number of deleted documents as reported by Lucene, which may be higher or lower than the number of delete operations you have performed.
This number excludes deletes that were performed recently and do not yet belong to a segment.
Deleted documents are cleaned up by the automatic merge process if it makes sense to do so.
Also, Elasticsearch creates extra deleted documents to internally track the recent history of operations on a shard.

generation.description: Generation number, such as `0`. Elasticsearch increments this generation number for each segment written then uses this number to derive the segment name.

search.description:
If `true`, the segment is searchable.
If `false`, the segment has most likely been written to disk but needs a refresh to be searchable.

merge_id.description: The ID of the merge the segment is part of. Only returned while the segment is being merged.

sort.description: The index sort of the segment. Only returned when the index is sorted.

size.description: Disk space used by the segment.

size_in_bytes.description: Disk space used by the segment, in bytes.

num_docs.description:
The number of documents as reported by Lucene.
This excludes deleted documents and counts any nested documents separately from their parents.
It also excludes documents which were indexed recently and do not yet belong to a segment.

version.description: Version of Lucene used to write the segment.

auto_calibration.description:
The auto-calibration information of the segment, per `dense_vector` field that supports auto-calibration.
Only returned when `include_auto_calibration` is `true`.

field.description: The name of the sort field.

mode.description: The selector used to pick a value from multi-valued fields, such as `min` or `max`. Only returned for numeric and keyword fields.

missing.description: The value used for documents that are missing the field.

reverse.description: If `true`, the sort order is descending.

indices.segments__SegmentAutoCalibration.description:
The auto-calibration information of a `dense_vector` field in a segment.

The shape of `parameters` depends on the quantization method of the field.

calibrated.description: If `true`, the segment has been calibrated, and `parameters` is present.

number_of_vectors.description: The number of vectors of the field in the segment.

size_in_bytes.description: The size of the vectors of the field in the segment, in bytes.
